notes: DiscoFlate v3.38.0 — no more save buttons: everything autosaves as you edit, and there's now ONE universal '💾 Save all' bar pinned to the bottom of every page as a manual safety. All the per-section Save buttons and the 'Restore Default Config' buttons are gone. The shipped defaults are now an IMMUTABLE built-in Gameplay Preset ('Defaults (built-in)' = Basic Session, minus the electrode event, with [operator] in place of any hard-coded name) — load it any time; it can't be edited/renamed/deleted/overwritten. A brand-new install now starts pre-loaded with it in every field. Presets also gained a ✏️ rename.
